rows.criterion: tape_seek(N) then tape_render emits frame N first, at every run boundary and +/-1 (V4-010)
covered_by: V95: 18 cases, 3 boundaries x {-1,0,+1} x both directions
rows.gap: Every accepted fixture puts each run at start_frame 0 of its own chunk, in ascending chunk order, on Side B. A non-zero start_frame, two runs sharing a chunk, a run spanning a chunk boundary, runs out of physical order and Side-A mounts are never exercised. An engine that ignores start_frame, sorts entries physically or wraps inside a chunk passes all accepted WP-08 evidence. playback_draft8 PB8-A04/05 has start_frames 10/20/30 and chunks 0,2,1 but is NONE-PB8.

rows.criterion: the engine-api 6.2/6.3/8 algorithms are the only implementation of the arithmetic

rows.note: A source-structure claim. A blind verifier cannot observe 'only implementation'; behavioural equivalence is covered. The full-domain section 8 claim is the WP-11 portability gate (proof plus executable differential), outside WP-08.
